_about: Nexa News sources. category: official (run by or linked from nexa.org / Bitcoin Unlimited) or independent (third-party coverage). type: feed (RSS/Atom), search (Bing News RSS, one URL per query), sitemap (read a sitemap, then only page metadata), reference (listed on the Sources page, not fetched), manual (never fetched; items are added by hand with ./fetch.sh --add URL). filter: all (every entry is about Nexa), nexa (needs a Nexa term with crypto context), strict (needs an unambiguous Nexa term). enabled=false means it is not fetched; see status.
user_agent: NexaNews/1.0 (non-commercial Nexa news aggregator; local test build)

sources.name: Nexa Forum
sources.status: ok: Discourse RSS, 30 latest topics. nexa.org/news links here, so this is also the official news feed. Topics by the official 'Nexa' and 'Wally' accounts are labelled official; topics by community members are labelled independent.

sources.name: nexa.org blog
sources.status: ok: no RSS feed (404 on /feed, /rss.xml, /feed.xml); article URLs come from the public sitemap and only title, description and date are read.

sources.name: nexa.org/news
sources.status: covered: the page lists Nexa Forum posts, which we read from the forum RSS.

sources.name: Bitcoin Unlimited Forum
sources.status: ok: Discourse RSS; only topics that mention Nexa are kept.

sources.name: Nexa full node releases (GitLab)
sources.status: ok: Atom feed

sources.name: Nexa full node tags (GitLab)
sources.status: ok: Atom feed (tags; releases are preferred when both exist)

sources.name: Rostrum releases (GitLab)
sources.status: ok: Atom feed (gitlab.com/nexa/rostrum serves the same releases)

sources.name: libnexakotlin releases (GitLab)
sources.status: ok: Atom feed

sources.name: libnexa-js tags (GitLab)
sources.status: ok: tag Atom feed (the releases feed is empty)

sources.name: Wally Wallet releases (GitLab)
sources.status: ok: Atom feed

sources.name: Otoplo Wallet releases (GitLab)
sources.status: ok: Atom feed (16 entries). Project is in the nexa/otoplo group; gitlab.com/otoplo/otoplo-wallet/otoplo-wallet is a separate mirror, not used.

sources.name: VotePeer (GitLab)
sources.status: reference: group is gitlab.com/groups/nexa/votepeer (libvotepeer, votepeer-multiplatform-app, votepeer-node-firebase, votepeer-web-legacy). No releases or tags yet, so no feed; add news by hand.

sources.name: jQrgen on Medium
sources.status: ok: Medium RSS (10 latest). Written by the site's owner; marked official because jQrgen works on Nexa.

sources.name: Medium tag: nexa
sources.status: ok: Medium tag RSS. Posts also found in an official feed are deduplicated to the official copy.

sources.name: Nexa on Medium (@nexacoin)
sources.status: failing: linked from nexa.org, but medium.com/feed/@nexacoin and nexacoin.medium.com/feed return 404. Add posts by hand.

sources.name: Bitcoin Unlimited on Medium
sources.status: ok, but inactive: latest post is from 2017.

sources.name: Bing News search
sources.status: ok: robots.txt allows it; Bing's feed terms allow personal, non-commercial RSS aggregation. Results are noisy (other companies called Nexa), so the filter and editor review matter.

sources.name: Google News RSS
sources.status: blocked: news.google.com/robots.txt disallows /rss for all bots. Not used.

sources.name: Mastodon #nexa (mastodon.social)
sources.status: ok but very noisy (fonts, cars, spyware company Nexa). Only posts with an unambiguous Nexa term are kept.

sources.name: r/Nexa (Reddit)
sources.status: manual only: reddit.com/robots.txt disallows all bots (including /r/Nexa/.rss). Add threads by hand with --add URL --title --date.

sources.name: Nexa on YouTube (@NexaCoin)
sources.status: manual only: youtube.com/robots.txt disallows /feeds/videos.xml. Add videos by hand. @NexaOrg and @nexa are not linked from nexa.org and are not used.

sources.name: Nexa on X (@NexaMoney)
sources.status: manual only: no free API and scraping breaks X's terms. Posts are added by URL and shown as a plain link card without X scripts.

sources.name: Bitcoin Unlimited on X (@BitcoinUnlimit)
sources.status: manual only: listed as BU's account on bitcoinunlimited.info. Add posts by URL.

sources.name: jQrgen on X (@jqrgensn)
sources.status: manual only: verified as the twitter_username on github.com/jQrgen (Jørgen S. Notland). Add posts by URL.

sources.name: Build On Nexa (BON)
sources.status: reference: developer docs with no feed. BON news is posted on the Nexa Forum.

sources.name: Nexa specification
sources.status: reference: technical spec with no feed

sources.name: Bitcoin Unlimited
sources.status: reference: no feed (/feed and /rss.xml return 404). BU news is on the BU forum.

sources.name: Nexa block explorer
sources.status: down: the researcher got HTTP 520 on 2026-10-03 (our own check that afternoon got 200, so it may be intermittent). Not a news source.

sources.name: Telegram
sources.status: not used (editor decision): t.me/nexacoin and t.me/nexa_mining are chat groups with no public preview. Warning: t.me/s/nexa_announcements is an unrelated BSC token called 'NXA', not Nexa.

sources.name: Discord
sources.status: not used (editor decision): a chat, not public articles

sources.name: CoinGecko / CoinMarketCap news
sources.status: not used: both sites' terms forbid scraping without their API, and their coin news is mostly price talk.

sources.name: Nostr
sources.status: not used: no stable public RSS bridge without third-party relays. Add notable notes by hand.
